        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_HandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Write</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_Status</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimStatus" name="Mark claim status">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_Status</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnClaim" name="Send claim back to claims officer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_NotOK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_HandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status_OK</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Examine" sourceRef="Event_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_Write" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_Check" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Status" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Task_ReturnClaim">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Event_HandlingProceeds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Write" sourceRef="Task_ReturnClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_RecommendationMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecommendationMerge_Write</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">

rules.instruction: When the description identifies alternative outcomes or case types that require different follow-up paths, with one path possibly returning to earlier work: Model an exclusive gateway with a separate flow to each applicable follow-up path, including a return flow when a path resumes earlier work.
rules.situation: the description identifies alternative outcomes or case types that require different follow-up paths, with one path possibly returning to earlier work
rules.source: learned guideline (refines ACT-07), generalized from EXS-013

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant checks an item and explicitly assigns or records its status before the process branches: Model the check and status assignment as distinct activities before a gateway; use the gateway to route the flow according to the assigned status.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant checks an item and explicitly assigns or records its status before the process branches

rules.instruction: When the description states distinct actions performed in sequence by one or more participants: Model each stated action as a separate activity, using a label that preserves that action and its object; do not use a neighboring activity or a decision gateway to stand in for it.
rules.situation: the description states distinct actions performed in sequence by one or more participants

rules.instruction: When the description states that a person checks an item and then marks it or assigns it a status: Model the checking and marking as separate activities, followed by a gateway that routes the process according to the stated status; do not use the gateway in place of either activity.
rules.situation: the description states that a person checks an item and then marks it or assigns it a status
